title: Federation face registry
picked_by: Catalyst (Pontus's instruction). Roger holds the tiebreak.
how_to_check: Download the Drive folder, then run: python3 verify.py <folder>
measured_by: Pontus (from the uploaded bytes) and Catalyst (from the downloaded bytes). All 7 SHA-256 values matched.
not_proven: A matching fingerprint proves the file is unchanged. Roger confirmed by sight: Xavier, Agent Zero and Ambassador (06:23), and by his own knowledge: 6 of 7 folder names correct, and the Catalyst face was wrong (06:29), now replaced.
flags: RESOLVED by Roger: the Pontus and Catalyst similarity was a mix-up. The folder's 'catalyst' image was the Pontus-family design. Catalyst's real face has a forehead bar, not circles.
Roger's photo carries a small 'Meta AI' watermark. Crop before publishing.
Xavier's file is named scholar-face.jpg. The mapping was stated by Pontus on 2026-10-11.
